desc: Compact Model 94 lever-action carbine with blued steel carbine strap buttplate. Marble Arms front sight and adjustable buckhorn rear sight. Drilled and tapped for scope mounts. The Winchester Model 94 is the world's most popular lever-action and today's rifles utilize the latest manufacturing technology to bring you the most accurate models ever produced. The Model 94 Carbine is a very special rendition of "the perfect lever-action". Its size and quickness is perfect for hunting in thick brush for deer, bear, wild hogs and other fast-moving game. Pick your Model 94 and pick out your target.
